description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationDao class, which manages database operations related to EmployeeEducation entities, including saving, retrieving by ID, deleting, and searching employee education records within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeEducation entity, providing CRUD and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEducation entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeEducation record by employee number and record ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmpEducationIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing EmployeeEducation record IDs for a given employee number matching a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEducations
methods.description: Deletes EmployeeEducation records for a specified employee and list of record IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Performs a search for EmployeeEducation records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for EmployeeEducation search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeEducation records matching the search filter parameters.
